findings.earliest_ends: EO:11873 replaces section 2 in full, changing congressional membership from two to four per chamber. Its complete immediate amendment has no deferred date: original section 2 first ends 1975-07-21. EO:11936 replaces section 4(c) in full without deferred effect: original section 4(c) first ends 1976-09-08. These are original-wording replacements, not abolition of the Commission; later revocation is correctly preserved for both replacement arrangements.
findings.inventory: All fourteen original operative spans cover sections 1-8 with separate 3(a-d),4(a-c),6(a-b). Overrides remove only page furniture after 3(c) and the editorial note after section 8. The complete held original contains no omitted operative provision or express self-termination. All dossier evidence spans and all derived clause spans match held text exactly.

findings.own_terms_and_performance: Original section 4(b) five-month and 4(c) seven-month intervals are report deadlines, not sunset clauses. EO:11936 replacement due date January 15, 1977 likewise does not terminate the Commission. The actual held texts supply no earlier completion event. No report submission or automatic cessation is inferred.
findings.revocation_date: EO:11948 section 3 specifically revokes EO:11868 as amended effective 1977-01-16. This target-specific provision governs over section 5 general effectiveness on 1976-12-31 and signature on 1976-12-20. The twelve remaining original clauses first end on 1977-01-16; whole-order end equals the latest first end.
findings.savings: Complete EO:11948 contains no savings or transfer applicable to EO:11868. Original sections 5-8 concern Commission advisory committees, HEW staff/support and expenses, compensation/travel and FACA administration. These are dependent authorities, not independent retained commands. Termination of prospective authority does not decide already accrued reimbursement; no particular continuing liability is established.
